confirmed: Single NTU-associated Xitou exhibition building; neighboring lodge/service building, park/scaffolding and sacred tree excluded.

Two raised square lightwells with four-sided glazed pyramidal caps and metal seams; cap is not an uncapped smoke chimney.
Offset teal entry panel with semicircular exterior arch, actual inward-open rectangular glazed door leaves behind it; not invented quarter-circle leaves or permanent doorless passage.
Projecting end fixed elongated arch window with sill, teal frame, shoulder setbacks and lower curved cap. Glazing is physical solid, not pedestrian opening.
Rear long wall and non-window short end remain blind, supported by plan/rear drawing/completed interior; rear surface pattern is explicitly estimated.
Woven slats are shallow curved relief over opaque backing, not through-perforated wall. Modelling preserves unequal front screen widths, low original raised floor and entrance step.
Interior behind entry is hollow, simplified divider disclosed; exterior rendering does not miscast interior double vaults as outside double roofs.
accepted_disclosed_simplifications: Roof shingle texture omitted as smooth dark green-grey roof; does not alter roof topology.
Interior unequal vault ceilings and sloping portions of light shafts omitted, wells simplified vertically; not a complete interior/BIM reconstruction.
Rear woven pattern, slat number/curves, small hardware, feet and 90-degree door angle approximate.
42 square metres is documentary scale context, not surveyed dimensions; all model millimetres are proportional estimates.
